teenKit.tldr: Australia and New Zealand are running the world's most advanced drug-policy laboratories, proving that real molecular biology and atomic geometry matter far more than parliamentary paperwork.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how drugs interact with receptors at the atomic scale helps us move past moral panic to design medical treatments and policies that actually save human lives.
